The '''Chosper system''' was located in the [[Lorelli Reach]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Lorell Route]] to the [[Andalia system/Legends|Andalia system]] and was also situated near<ref name="TEA" /> the dense network of hyperlanes known as the "[[Knot Holes]],"<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref> which linked it to [[Telkur Station]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Chosper [[Star system/Legends|system]] shared its name with the exclamation "Nimbus of Chosper!".<ref name-"Betrayal">''[[Jabba the Hutt: Betrayal]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Chosper system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
